latest_release.body:
Memos 26.11.2 shows comments alongside memos in lists, lets you reorder saved Views, and adds a full-width timeline. Calendar navigation, MariaDB compatibility, and editor reliability also improve.

## Highlights

* **Comments in lists:** Turn on Include comments in Settings > Preferences > This device to show comments beside memos in every memo list. A comment in a list names its parent memo on a strip above its card. ([comments as memos](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/8b61d2e9d626eae7483731513beac5ed383fc39d))
* **Timeline width:** A Full width option in the timeline display menu lets memos use the whole timeline instead of a centered column. ([#6557](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6557))
* **Views:** Reorder saved Views with Move up and Move down in each row's menu. ([reorder Views](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/40185270f0328565b974fd8986e1a01c3fd00fbd))

## Fixes and polish

* **Editor:** The audience picker says who can read a memo: only you, Space members, signed-in users, or everyone. A space typed after a Korean IME commit stays after the word in Markdown mode. Link memo search finds text containing quotes or backslashes. Save, Update, and Comment show progress while a request is running. ([audience picker](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/f4c95effd686395cb4f6f3230a816ad5a1b40475), [Korean IME](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/5e4bfcd008c06942569a1a56fb49f02ed8698562), [#6583](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6583), [button states](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/ec132044edea7213da74496cbca38c13bcd539b8))
* **Attachments and sharing:** Thumbnails of externally linked attachments, such as those created by an import, no longer render blank. Copying a share link works on instances served over plain HTTP. ([#6574](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6574), [#6576](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6576))
* **Tags:** Settings > Tags counts memos for rules written as patterns instead of showing 0. ([#6591](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6591))
* **Calendar:** The month picker marks the months that hold memos and lists the years they span, and arrow keys move across months and years. Titles, weekday labels, and dates share one text axis, the month fits the viewport on medium screens, excerpt text keeps its contrast on busy days, and a month that fails to load says so instead of looking empty. ([calendar fixes](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/bbc168e845725636ba51df473b9c2e94fb647774))
* **Interface:** The sidebar uses one text size with aligned trailing controls, today is outlined in the sidebar calendar, action menus use a horizontal ellipsis, and sign-in buttons show progress. ([sidebar](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/00fcd170281a75fc0e95ec4f2f54f43d32fe81bd), [action menus](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/1825ae440fdfd7201ce0ff96a4414933402311ef), [#6590](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6590), [button states](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/ec132044edea7213da74496cbca38c13bcd539b8))
* **Performance:** Long memos parse faster when memos are listed, saved, or imported. ([#6595](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6595))
* **Export:** An archive of more than 500 memos no longer records a link between two memos twice. ([#6599](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6599))

## Administration and integrations

* **MariaDB:** The 26.11.1 attachment index migration failed on MariaDB with `Unknown column 'IS_VISIBLE'` and stopped the instance from starting. The migration now runs on MariaDB, JSON boolean filters and strict `ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY` grouping work, and MariaDB 11.4 is part of the store and upgrade test suites. ([#6571](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6571), [#6572](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6572))
* **Windows ARM64:** Releases include a `windows_arm64` binary. ([#6577](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6577))

detail.readme:
> ✨ Featured sponsor: [CodeRabbit — Industry-leading AI code reviews](https://coderabbit.link/usememos).

### Simple note-taking for your everyday thoughts. Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app that brings your everyday thoughts together in a personal timeline. Your data stays yours, and you choose what to keep private or share. [Demo](https://demo.usememos.com) · [Install](#quick-start) · [Docs](https://usememos.com/docs) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/tfPJa4UmAv) [![Docker pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/neosmemo/memos?style=flat-square&logo=docker)](https://hub.docker.com/r/neosmemo/memos) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/usememos/memos?style=flat-square&label=Release)](https://github.com/usememos/memos/releases) ## About Memos Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app for your everyday thoughts. - **Everyday writing.** A single sentence can be a whole memo, or you can take your time with a longer entry, using Markdown to give your words more structure. - **A personal timeline.** Each memo stays with the day you wrote it, bringing your thoughts together in a timeline you can look back through. Tags connect related thoughts across those days, making it easy to pick up a topic again or find something you remember writing. - **Your own data.** Your record lives on your own server, and your data stays yours. - **Sharing you control.** You choose what stays private, what to share with family and friends, and what to publish on the web. In shared spaces, you can write alongside others while each person keeps their own memos. ## Quick start With Docker installed, run: ```bash docker run -d \ --name memos \ -p 5230:5230 \ -v ~/.memos:/var/opt/memos \ neosmemo/memos:stable ``` Open http://localhost:5230 and create the first account. Everything Memos keeps is in `~/.memos`, so back up that one folder. Other ways to run Memos, including Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and a plain binary, are in the [deployment guide](https://usememos.com/docs/deploy). ## Upgrading Releases are tagged `YY.MM.N`, with release candidates as `YY.MM.N-rc.K` and no `v` prefix. The Docker tag `stable` follows stable releases, a month tag such as `26.10` follows the newest stable release of that month, and `canary` follows development builds. Coming from a release before v0.31.0, run [v0.31.0](https://github.com/usememos/memos/releases/tag/v0.31.0) once first; see the [upgrade requirements](store/migration/README.md). ## Around Memos - [Web Clipper](https://usememos.com/web-clipper) for [Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/memos-web-clipper/nebaoebnljalfegiidibihhkebeiklbl) and [Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/memos-web-clipper/) saves pages, selections, and images to your memos as Markdown with a link to the source. - [Memogram](https://github.com/usememos/telegram-integration) is a Telegram bot that saves your messages and images to Memos. - The [API](https://usememos.com/docs/api/latest) and [MCP server](https://usememos.com/docs/integrations/mcp) connect Memos to your own scripts and AI tools. ## Sponsors

      

Sponsor Memos through [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/usememos). ## Help and contributing Questions go to the [docs](https://usememos.com/docs), [Discord](https://discord.gg/tfPJa4UmAv), or [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/usememos/memos/discussions). Bugs and ideas go to [issues](https://github.com/usememos/memos/issues/new/choose). Code changes start with the [contributing guide](https://usememos.com/docs/development/contributing). ## Star History
